test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In how much time (in years) will ₹8,000 amount to ₹9,159.20 at 14% per annum interest compounded half yearly?
solution:
**Formula:**

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

A = Amount

Calculation:

We have rate i.e., 14% compounded annually. 

⇒ rate compounded half-yearly = 14 ÷ 2 = 7%.

Substituting the value of rate in the Amount equation-

⇒ 9,159.20 = 8000 × (1+7over100)T

⇒ 9159.20over8000 = (1+7over100)T

⇒ (107over100)² = (107over100)T

∴ T = 2 half-years or 1 year

**The required time is 1 year.**
